findings: Inventory rollback bug when state is desynced — Purchase filter checks Discord roles but not inventory. If a user has an inventory entry without the Discord role (from prior manual removal or partial failure), buying that item again passes the filter, increments inventory, then rollback decrements inventory. Net effect: inventory count ends up 1 higher than pre-purchase. Fix: either check inventory in the filter or snapshot inventory state before purchase and restore exact values on rollback.

No TypeScript compilation verification — Requirements state 'TypeScript compiles with no errors (coder should have logged the result)' but no build output provided. Cannot confirm this requirement is met.

Shop refresh may silently fail — Post-purchase refresh uses interaction.message?.edit() which handles null safely but won't update the shop if the message is deleted or the context is missing. Current collector setup makes this unlikely, but the edge case exists.
